mapper.select: WITH MONTHLY AS ( SELECT TO_CHAR(ORD_DT, 'YYYYMM') AS YM, TOT_AMT FROM TB_ORD_H WHERE ORD_STAT_CD = '90' UNION ALL SELECT TO_CHAR(ORD_DT, 'YYYYMM') AS YM, TOT_AMT FROM TB_ORD_H_ARCH ) SELECT M.YM AS ym, SUM(M.TOT_AMT) AS salesAmt FROM MONTHLY M GROUP BY M.YM ORDER BY ym

WITH STAT_CD AS ( SELECT CD, CD_NM FROM TB_CMM_CD WHERE GRP_CD = 'ORD_STAT' ) SELECT S.CD_NM AS statNm, COUNT(H.ORD_NO) AS cnt FROM STAT_CD S LEFT JOIN TB_ORD_H H ON H.ORD_STAT_CD = S.CD GROUP BY S.CD_NM
